summary: Iteration 12 regression testing (refactor/security only). Backend: 75/75 pytest tests green (test_iteration10 + 11 + new test_iteration12) — conftest dynamic B2B token resolution verified without TEST_B2B_TOKEN env (POST /api/contacts/cnt_01/b2b-access → token works against /api/public/b2b/{token}, idempotent), banking connections list/test/sync verified (sha256 simulation seed produces 3-6 movements, external_id dedupe makes a 2nd sync insert 0, unknown conn → 404), plus 19 page-level GET endpoints smoke-checked for 200 + no _id leak. Frontend: all 18 routes loaded with real data; NO infinite request loops (0 API calls after the first ~1.3s in 20s observation windows), no React runtime console errors. Verified filter/tab re-fetch behaviour on stock (category chip), contacts (type filter), installments (status/direction filters), reports (report type + date change), personnel (izin/prim/puantaj + month change), banking (Ortaklar / Banka Entegrasyonu), settings (Birimler & Kategoriler, B2B Portal), communication (E-posta empty state, SMS, WhatsApp), ecommerce product-mapping panel, cargo catalog. ContactDetailPanel opens/loads all tabs (Faturalar/Ödemeler/Taksitler with installments+accounts fetch)/closes; ProductionOrderModal auto-selects the recipe and loads the requirement table; ApproveOrderModal pre-selects the carrier (Yurtiçi) and cancels cleanly; B2B portal cart writes localStorage b2b_cart_<token> and survives reload. ESLint: 0 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings and 0 eslint-disable suppressions → the 44→0 claim is genuine.

minor.issue: The `mode` field is ignored: bank_providers.test_connection/fetch_transactions decide simulation purely by has_credentials(). A connection saved with client_id/secret AND mode='simulation' performs a live OAuth call; in the preview sandbox DNS fails and /sync returns 502 with status=error. Simulation mode should short-circuit before any network call.
Invoiced orders cannot be removed (400 'Faturalanmış sipariş silinemez') and there is no DELETE for invoices (405). Combined with the test leak below, test data is unremovable through the API.

integration_issues.issue: Each initial GET is fired 4x on mount (2x React StrictMode double-invoke + 2 more from a companyId/auth-resolution re-render): /invoices = 20 API calls, /stock = 18, /personnel = 16. Not a loop (all within ~1.3s, nothing after 5s) but redundant; gate loads until activeCompany is resolved.

issues: Native browser date/month pickers (input type=date/month) instead of the shadcn calendar component
React DOM nesting warnings in console: '<th> cannot be a child of <table>' (orders table) and '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (atolye station select) — hydration warnings, pre-existing
Catalog exposes test/seed noise to customers: product 'deneme' and 'drc70' with 0,00 ₺ price

action_items: bank_providers.py: honour conn['mode']=='simulation' (skip live OAuth/HTTP) so a saved-credentials connection in simulation mode cannot 502.

test_iteration11.py::TestConvertToInvoice::test_convert_paper_resolves_contact leaks one B2B order + invoice per run (18 'TEST_IT11_CONV' orders now in DB, not deletable via API) — add real teardown (cancel invoice + delete order, or direct mongo cleanup).
Reduce the 4x duplicate initial fetches per page (skip load while activeCompany/companyId is unresolved).

Test isolation under pytest.ini's `-n 2 --dist loadscope`: test_iteration10/11 both mutate the shared cargo 'geliver' provider and it11/it12 both resolve the cnt_01 B2B token via a mutating POST at import time → observed 2 cross-worker flakes. I added a leftover-cleanup guard to it10; consider distinct carrier codes per file and a locked/session-scoped token resolution.
critical_code_review_comments: bank_providers.fetch_transactions/test_connection ignore the persisted `mode` flag — simulation is inferred only from missing credentials; this makes 'simulation' mode misleading and returns 502 on sandbox DNS failure.

MailClient folder switching is driven by explicit loadMessages(f) inside onClick and the mount effect only depends on stable useCallbacks — no INBOX reset regression (code-verified; live IMAP untestable, no mail account configured).
ProductionOrderModal recipe auto-select effect uses setRecipeId((cur) => cur || ...) so a user selection is not overwritten — correct.
conftest.resolve_b2b_token() performs a state-mutating POST at module import in every xdist worker; prefer a read-only lookup or a session lock to avoid cross-worker races.

rca_of_the_issue: First parallel pytest run showed 2 cargo failures (geliver 'zaten ekli' 400 + catalog installed=True). RCA: test_iteration10 and test_iteration11 both add/delete the same 'geliver' cargo provider and pytest.ini pins them to different xdist workers running concurrently, so leftover state from an aborted earlier run plus the race made them fail; a later run also hit a 404 in it11 TestB2BOrders because it11 and it12 both resolve the cnt_01 B2B token with a mutating POST at import time. Serial (-n 0) runs were always green. Mitigation applied (test-code only): idempotency guard test in it10 that deletes leftover navlungo/geliver before the suite; verified 5 consecutive green parallel runs. Not application code — no product behaviour changed.
